_about: Config for .github/scripts/{build,check,smoke}_release_tree.py (#2705, ported from claude-remember#851). The `release` branch is what the Anthropic plugin directory fetches; master keeps everything. See docs/releasing.md.
_deny_why: Deny-list, not allow-list: a path forgotten here ships and is caught loudly by the size/count check; a path forgotten in an allow-list would vanish from users' installs silently. Entry ending in '/' = directory prefix, otherwise an exact path.
_kept_why: _shipped_reference.py is NOT denied: it is the fallback _shipped_config() reads when .supertool.json is absent beside _supertool.py (the pip-install route, #1783) -- and this release tree denies .supertool.json, so the fallback is load-bearing here. .mcp.json ships because it registers the claude-channel notifier the plugin manifest declares.
_budget_why: max_file_bytes and max_files are the directory's own rules (pre-submission checklist, 'Files in the plugin folder'); images and fonts are exempt from the per-file limit. max_total_bytes is this repository's own ceiling, set from the measured slim tree (6.4 MiB after the CHANGELOG cut) with headroom.
_exceptions_why: A declared exception lets check_release_tree.py report a REVIEW line instead of a FAIL for a named, issue-referenced path over max_file_bytes. Any other oversize file still fails -- this is not a second deny-list.

exceptions.reason: the tool itself, 1.7 MiB; cannot be denied (it is what the plugin runs); splitting it is tracked separately in #2706
